messages:
alex: Quick heads up 1: we're doing a low-risk base-image rebuild tonight in staging to pick up a patch. Need ephemeral RBAC for CI to sign with KMS and DATA_ACCESS audit enabled.

maria: I can create the ephemeral binding. Plan: grant roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier to ci-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com with an IAM condition limiting to the rebuild job and TTL 2 hours. No decrypt or key admin.

ops-oncall: Ops will enable KMS DATA_ACCESS audit logs and route to project-sec-logs with 395d retention and retention lock. Also will create a log sink for the rebuild window.

sec-bot: auto: vuln-scan found kde-libc-1.0.2 in base-slim:v2026-04 (medium). Recommended: rebuild with patched libc or pin upstream fix.

alex: Good. Maria please paste minimal YAML in this thread once done. Ops please confirm the sink name. We'll run canaries after signing.

maria: Pasted minimal snippet in PR and scheduled teardown job to remove binding after TTL.

ops-oncall: Sink: projects/project-sec-logs/sinks/kms-data-access-rebuild-2026-04. Confirmed.

alex: Thanks all. Opening follow-up for post-build attestations and BigQuery row logging.
